name: bankconv
description: Convert PDF bank statements to transactions, CSV, OFX, QFX, QBO or Xero CSV.
long_description: Convert PDF bank and credit card statements from your AI assistant. Ask for the transactions (ISO dates, one signed amount, running balance; opening balances and totals left out) to analyse them, or for a file saved next to the PDF: CSV, OFX for Xero, MYOB, Sage and QuickBooks Online, QFX for Quicken, QBO Web Connect for QuickBooks Desktop, or Xero CSV. Reads password-protected and scanned PDFs. Needs a BankConv API key; conversions use the pages of your BankConv account.

tools.name: convert_statement
tools.description: Convert a PDF bank or credit card statement on this computer with BankConv. Use this for a new PDF; for a statement converted earlier, use get_transactions or download_statement with its conversion id (list_conversions finds it). With output "transactions" (the default) it returns a summary and every transaction as JSON: ISO date, description, signed amount (money in positive), running balance; opening balances and totals are left out. Any other output saves that file and returns only its path and any warnings. csv: the statement as a spreadsheet; ofx: Xero, Sage, MYOB, QuickBooks Online; qfx: Quicken; qbo: QuickBooks Desktop (Web Connect); xero: Xero CSV with Xero's own columns. Uploading uses one BankConv page per PDF page. Waits until the conversion finishes. Errors say what went wrong: not_found for an unknown conversion id, gone once a conversion was deleted under data retention (24 hours by default), unreadable_statement when the tables can't be read as transactions (the message names the row), insufficient_credits when the account has too few pages.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Get the transactions of an earlier BankConv conversion by its conversion id (from convert_statement or list_conversions): ISO date, description, signed amount (money in positive) and running balance, with the bank, account, period and currency. Read-only; uses no pages. To save a file instead, use download_statement. Errors say what went wrong: not_found for an unknown conversion id, gone once a conversion was deleted under data retention (24 hours by default), unreadable_statement when the tables can't be read as transactions (the message names the row), insufficient_credits when the account has too few pages.

tools.name: download_statement
tools.description: Save an earlier BankConv conversion as a file on this computer, by its conversion id (from convert_statement or list_conversions). Returns the saved path and any warnings (for example a bank QuickBooks doesn't list), not the file contents. Uses no pages. csv: the statement as a spreadsheet; ofx: Xero, Sage, MYOB, QuickBooks Online; qfx: Quicken; qbo: QuickBooks Desktop (Web Connect); xero: Xero CSV with Xero's own columns. Errors say what went wrong: not_found for an unknown conversion id, gone once a conversion was deleted under data retention (24 hours by default), unreadable_statement when the tables can't be read as transactions (the message names the row), insufficient_credits when the account has too few pages.

tools.name: list_conversions
tools.description: List the BankConv account's recent conversions, newest first, one line each: conversion id, status, file name, page count and upload time. Use it to find the id of an earlier conversion for get_transactions or download_statement, or to check on one still processing. Read-only.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Check how many BankConv pages the account has left in the current period, as JSON. Each PDF page uses one page, so check before converting a large batch. Read-only.
